SELECT COUNT(*) as not_finished_count 
FROM results r 
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.time IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_drivers, SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as finished, SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_finished
FROM results r 
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007
